changelog.title: WP-00: contracts frozen before the agents fan out
changelog.body: Before several agents build in parallel, everything they share gets pinned down first: 49 typed tables generated from the models, 11 state machines, 36 event types, and one connection contract with a mock for each of the 16 outside capabilities. 114 tests pass against a real Postgres. After the freeze, additive changes are allowed and breaking ones are not, so packages can be built side by side without stepping on each other.

changelog.title: Plan of record: 42 work packages in 8 waves
changelog.body: The full build is split into 42 self-contained work packages across 8 waves. Each package has an owner, a file scope, its dependencies and a test that says it is done. Every wave ends in a working system, so the build can pause after any wave and still be usable, and real businesses start using it once Wave 2 lands.
